surface_observation.note: The public surface establishes a history-explainer channel identity and an exact representative battle-reconstruction title. Runtime, full visual timeline, audio, and source presentation were not observable in this pass. The measured contract therefore stays a bounded chronology-first authoring backcast and does not claim frame-level reproduction.

measured_contract.narration_model: bounded authoring contract: two-speaker dialogue in which one role advances the chronology and the other tests causes, date transitions, and institutional consequences
measured_contract.chapter_model: concrete present-day question, precondition, international turning point, domestic ordinance, implementation, later scope change, present-day consequence, ordered recap
measured_contract.visual_grammar: original date cards, map and meridian diagrams, ordinance cards, and before-after institutional summaries; no benchmark frames
measured_contract.subtitle_grammar: two-line readable dialogue subtitles with years, ordinance numbers, longitude, and effective dates stated in speech
measured_contract.asset_switching: one causal or chronological thesis per chapter, with explicit date transitions rather than decorative rapid cuts
measured_contract.audio_grammar: YMM4 two-character TTS with no benchmark voice, audio, music, or effects
measured_contract.pacing: question, dated event, reason, and consequence cycle across seven chronological chapters
measured_contract.source_attribution: tracked claim registry points to public institutional sources; source media is not embedded
measured_contract.intro_outro: present-day meridian question at the opening and an ordered rule-change-plus-present-system recap at the close
